The supplied ASan crash occurs in ndpi_strncasestr around ndpi/src/lib/ndpi_main.c:7152, called by HTTP Authorization processing in ndpi/src/lib/protocols/http.c:728. A mixed-case Authorization header containing only spaces gets trimmed to length zero, then code searches it for the five-byte literal "Basic". The current helper reportedly computes a size_t loop limit as str1_len - str2_len + 1 without first establishing str1_len >= str2_len, causing unsigned wraparound and out-of-bounds reads. I am evaluating a minimal generic helper fix rather than an HTTP-specific guard and want to preserve existing helper behavior, especially for str1_len == 0 and empty needles.
